title: World file of one venue of racecar_time_trial_on_unseen_track (sketch contract sketch-contract/1.0)
description: One venue. `venue_sheet` is the only public part (describe() returns it verbatim); `truth` and everything else belong to the grader. Frames and units: world frame, x and y horizontal, z up, metres; yaw counter-clockwise from +x in radians; a point is [x, y], a pose is [x, y, yaw]. Every float is rounded to 6 decimals when written. The semantic rules that a schema cannot express are in the contract and in sketch/examples/check.py.

world_id.description: Hidden identifier of the venue (file name stem).

layout_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON text of {schema, venue_sheet, truth}; verify compares it at every reset.

pose.description: [x, y, yaw]: metres, metres, radians counter-clockwise from +x.

wall_class.description: Orange / yellow duct with black ribs (full LiDAR range) or plain black duct (short LiDAR range; the range per class is the sensor model's sensor parameter).

name.description: `hand` for a hand-written world, otherwise the generator's name.

seed_hex.description: The os.urandom candidate seed (hex) the world was generated from; null for a hand-written world.

venue_sheet.description: PUBLIC. What the organiser tells every team about this venue: kinds and bounds, no layout, no positions, no grip value of this car.

venue_label.description: A neutral label of the venue; never a real place, platform or vendor name.

side_pull.description: The organiser's side-pull reading: peak sideways force that moved the organiser's reference car (its own mass, its own tyres) at one spot. A hint only: implied friction = peak_force_n / (test_mass_kg * 9.81) of another tyre. null when the organiser publishes none (lever T2).

kinds.description: Wall kinds that may stand at this venue (every kind in use, possibly more).

min_width_m.description: The organiser's promise: no section is narrower (a lower bound of the real minimum).

max_footprint_m.description: [x, y] size of the area the track fits in (an upper bound of the real footprint).

features.description: Exactly the feature kinds present at this venue; no counts, no positions.

grip_tier.description: Tier of the base grip: low 0.45-0.55, mid 0.60-0.75, high 0.80-0.95; `lab` for a world outside the hidden set.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned footprint of the track including its walls, centred on the world origin, longer side along x.

stats.description: Numbers the generator reports about the layout; the checker recomputes them.

width_ge_1p5_frac.description: Share of the centreline length where the track is at least 1.5 m wide.

centreline.description: The closed centreline in driving order and the half widths at every sample. Station s = polyline length from sample 0; `left` / `right` = distance from the centreline to the track-side face of the wall on the left / right of the driving direction.

items.description: [x, y, half width left, half width right] in metres.

walls.description: Wall lines: each an ordered chain of ducts. Between consecutive ducts of a chain (and between the last and the first of a closed chain) there is exactly one entry of `gaps` or `open_walls`.

side.description: Which side of the driving direction the wall bounds; `shared` = one row of ducts between two sections of the track less than 0.5 m apart.

ducts.description: Every duct as a chain of rigid pieces lying on the floor. A full duct is 7.62 m = 15 pieces of 0.508 m; a compressed duct is shorter. Piece k (0-based, in the order of the wall) is the cylinder of diameter 0.33 m and length piece_length_m whose axis midpoint is at [x, y] (0.165 m above the floor) and whose axis points along yaw toward piece k + 1; consecutive pieces share their end points.

gaps.description: Every junction of two consecutive ducts of a wall that is not an open wall: the end gap between the head end of ducts[0] and the tail end of ducts[1]; width 0 = butted.

ends.description: Centres of the two facing end faces (on the duct axes): head of ducts[0], tail of ducts[1].

open_walls.description: Openings of 0.6-1.2 m in a wall whose boundary is a tape line on the floor, invisible to the LiDAR.

ends.description: Centres of the two facing end faces: head of ducts[0], tail of ducts[1].

tape.description: The tape line: the straight segment between the track-side edges of the two duct ends, i.e. each end centre moved one duct radius toward the track, square to the axis of its end piece (tape[0] at ducts[0], tape[1] at ducts[1]).

outward.description: Unit normal of the tape pointing out of the track.

track_width_m.description: Track width at s_m; the opening is narrower.

floor.description: The floor as data. grip = the friction coefficient of this car's tyres on the surface (full braking decelerates at grip x g; the drive model's gate). grip_at(x, y) = grip of the last listed patch containing the point, otherwise base_grip.

polygon.description: Simple polygon, counter-clockwise; a rectangle when edge_height_m > 0.

edge_height_m.description: Height of the patch's top face above the floor; 0 = flush (no geometry in the model).

on_racing_line.description: True when the patch covers the driving line in a bend.

clutter.description: Proxies of what stands outside the track (hall pillars, table legs, crates, roll-up banners): static, no contact, LiDAR targets seen through gaps and open walls; at least 0.5 m from any wall.

pose.description: Centre of the footprint on the floor and yaw.

size_m.description: [size along local x, size along local y, height]; a cylinder has size[0] == size[1] = its diameter. The proxy stands on the floor.

reflectivity.description: LiDAR class: `dark` has the short range of the plain black duct.

timing_line.description: The start / finish line. A lap is timed between two forward crossings of this line by the car's reference point with every checkpoint crossed forward in order in between.

checkpoints.description: Hidden gates in driving order after the timing line.

start_pose.description: Where the car (car frame origin and yaw) stands, at rest, when a session opens.

avoidance.description: What the organiser puts on the track in the avoidance test; none of it exists in the other sessions.

size_m.description: [x, y, z] size of the cardboard box.

pose.description: Centre of the footprint on the floor and yaw at the start of the session.

free_passage_m.description: Width of the wider passage the box leaves between itself and a wall.

speed_factor.description: The slow car drives at speed_factor x the reference speed of its path.

gap_keep_m.description: It slows down when something is within this distance ahead (0.8 m).

entry_s_m.description: Station where the car is put on the track when the dynamic phase starts (the obstacle model's placement rule may shift it away from the ego car).

staging_pose.description: Where the car waits, hidden and without contact, before it enters: at least 1 m outside bounds.

items.description: [x, y, reference speed in m/s] in driving order.

seeds.description: Fixed seeds of this venue; each feeds one numpy.random.default_rng(seed) created when the venue is built.

relocation.description: Position and heading errors of the car when the staff put it back.

putback.description: Errors of ducts and boxes when the staff put them back.

sensors.description: Noise and bias of the LiDAR, the IMU and the wheel speed.

a.description: End point on the left boundary of the corridor.

b.description: End point on the right boundary of the corridor.

forward.description: Unit vector of the driving direction at the line; a crossing counts when the reference point passes the segment a-b along it.
